description: List the active token approvals an account has granted, newest first, with a summary (total, distinct tokens, ERC-20 USD value at risk). Allowances are the approved amounts, not the live remaining allowance. Pages hold 25 items; fetch the next page while hasMore is true.

contractAddress.description: Account address that granted the approvals (0x-prefixed hex).

network.description: Network to query. Defaults to the server's configured network (mainnet).

scope.description: type=erc721 only: "token" for per-NFT approvals (default) or "operator" for ApprovalForAll.

name: get_contract_approvals
